verified_runtime_facts: All three samples used the same release preflight identity, dataset fingerprint, question, model, planning context, and Planner schema fingerprint.
The baseline and 5C5S trial 1 returned the same ready multi_finding_synthesis plan identity.
5C5S trial 2 returned a contract-valid needs_input plan with two questions, HTTP 201, one consumed authorization, one Provider call, and zero retries.
No deterministic continuation, clarification answer, follow-up planning, repair, or retry occurred after trial 2.

verified_code_facts.needs_input_schema_availability: The needs_input variant is offered for every DatasetPlanningContext and requires only empty route fields plus one to three non-empty questions.
verified_code_facts.system_prompt_decision_boundary: The prompt describes the payload shape for ready, needs_input, and unsupported but does not define a server-owned eligibility predicate for choosing needs_input.
verified_code_facts.compiler_decision_boundary: The compiler accepts needs_input whenever route fields are empty and at least one question exists; it does not verify that a controlled prerequisite is actually absent from the context.
verified_code_facts.existing_test_boundary: Tests cover status/payload shape, bounded clarifications, and route absence; they do not cover semantic justification for needs_input on an otherwise executable context.

root_cause_assessment.confirmed_shared_contract_gap: needs_input eligibility is not bound to a deterministic, server-owned missing-prerequisite contract
root_cause_assessment.confirmed_context_gap: planning metadata does not explicitly state row grain or the business semantics of the observational unit
root_cause_assessment.why_not_a_transport_or_parser_bug: The response passed Provider transport, tool shape, local compilation, persistence, and authorization checks.
root_cause_assessment.why_not_safe_to_force_ready: A coarse identifier role and unique-looking name do not by themselves prove the independent observational unit required by inferential methods.

next_red_regressions: A complete context with a server-verified executable prerequisite set must reject an unjustified needs_input result before publication.
A genuinely incomplete context must retain needs_input and identify missing prerequisites through controlled codes rather than only free-form questions.
Tool schema, system contract, compiler, Plan Ledger, and HTTP projection must agree on the controlled missing-prerequisite identity.
No clarification answer, repair, retry, or fallback may be generated automatically.
